dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity normalized pixel values across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of low-contrast, fine linear markings or skin folds on the mid-dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized faint linear scratches or rake marks are visible on the mid-dorsal canvas.
